summary.text: Stephen Wooden is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives from District 81 who took office on January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A nonprofit professional, he previously served on the Kent County Commission.

paragraphs.text: Wooden was born in Austin, Texas, and earned a bachelor's degree from Michigan State University in 2013.
He has been affiliated with the Creston Neighborhood Association.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Wooden said he was elected to the Kent County Commission in 2018 and had worked for seven years at the housing nonprofit Dwelling Place of Grand Rapids.
Wooden succeeded Democrat Rachel Hood in District 81.
In the 2025-2026 session he is minority vice chair of the Elections and Ethics Committee and serves on the Natural Resources and Outdoor Recreation Committee.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Holly DeBoer in the general election on November 3, 2026.
In the 2024 survey, Wooden listed housing costs, childcare, public schools and job training, environmental and climate policy, and reproductive freedom as his policy priorities.
